scope: Swap-growth history supplied to the Java scheduler policy; no native effects.
selection: Accepted Policy already consumes swapRecovery separately from current native memoryPressure. Java per-instance state and exact primitive byte comparisons implement this local value mapping; no additional external capability, parser or scheduling policy is introduced.
contract: First successful sample establishes baseline without claiming growth. Later growth latches an incident. The latch persists during pressure and clears on a non-growing sample without pressure. Negative input is rejected without mutating history. Instances belong to one controller thread; unsuccessful native reads must not call observe.
